players.bio: Andreas Weimann (born 5 August 1991) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town. He also plays for the Austria national team. He was signed by Aston Villa as a sixteen-year-old from Rapid Wien and went on to make 129 total appearances and score 24 goals for the Premier League club.

Ben Edward Stevenson (born 23 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town. Stevenson is a graduate of the Coventry City Academy. He spent 13 years with the club, joining at the age of eight. He made his professional debut in August 2016 and made 48 appearances for the club.

Charlie Liam McCann (born 24 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town. Born in England, he represents Northern Ireland at youth level.
Favour Onukwuli (born 9 April 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for Cheltenham Town F.C. in EFL League Two.
Freddy Willcox (often referred to as Freddy Willcox) is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who currently plays as a midfielder for Cheltenham Town.
George Miller (born 11 August 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Cheltenham Town.
George Damien Nurse (born 30 April 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full back.
Jake Bickerstaff (born 11 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two side Cheltenham Town.
Jake Benjamin Evans (born 21 August 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town.

James Steven Wilson (born 26 February 1989) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for Cheltenham Town. He has also represented Wales at international level. Primarily a central back, he can also play at right back.
Joseph David Day (born 13 August 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town where he also holds the role of goalkeeping coach.

Joseph William George Tomlinson (born 9 June 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Cheltenham Town. Tomlinson spent his early career with Southampton, Yeovil Town, Brighton & Hove Albion and Bognor Regis Town. He was released by Brighton at the end of the 2018–19 season. He then played for Hungerford Town, where he was appointed captain at the age of 19.
Jonathan Robert Tomkinson (born April 11, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town.

Jordan Mark Edward James Shipley (born 26 September 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town. Born in England, he has played for the Republic of Ireland U21 national team.

Kirsten Fiifi Yamoah Otchere (born 6 October 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town, on loan from EFL League One club Leicester City.
Mamadou Diallo is an 18-year-old English goalkeeper who plays for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town .
Pierce Liam Sweeney (born 11 September 1994) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Cheltenham Town.
Robbie David Cundy (born 30 May 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town.

Ryan James Broom (born 4 September 1996) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a right midfielder or right winger for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town. Ryan Broom graduated from Bristol Rovers' youth set-up in 2015 and made his professional football debut in August 2015
Shaun Daniel McWilliams is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two side Cheltenham Town.

Stephen John Cotterill (born 20 July 1964) is an English football manager and former player. He is the manager of EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town. Cotterill had a nine-year career as a footballer playing for Burton Albion, Wimbledon, Brighton & Hove Albion and AFC Bournemouth before deciding to take up football management.
Wylliam Sam Stanway is an English football goalkeeper and former cricketer who currently plays for EFL League Two club Cheltenham Town.
